children: Hong Kong, September 23, 2026-- Moody's Ratings has upgraded Bosideng International Holdings Limited's issuer rating to Baa2 from Baa3. The outlook for the rating has changed to stable from positive.  "The upgrade reflects Bosideng International's track record of growing its revenue and earnings under the backdrop of sluggish consumption growth in China, while maintaining an excellent financial profile.

title: Moody's Ratings upgrades Bosideng International's issuer rating to Baa2; outlook stable
